caption: The drawing depicts a single copper kettle with a slightly rounded, cylindrical body and a sloped, circular lid. The kettle is colored in varying shades of reddish-brown, indicating the copper material, with subtle highlights and shadows that give the surface a mildly tarnished and worn appearance. The spout, which emerges diagonally from the right side, is slender, elongated, and curves upward at the tip. The handle is attached to the top of the lid with metal brackets on either side and features a central grip area that appears to be made of a darker material, possibly wood, with two cylindrical copper bands flanking it. The background consists of a plain, light beige or off-white area, unadorned and without details, except for the artist's signature, "Eugene Croe," written in the lower right corner in blue ink or pencil. There are also small crosshair-like marks near the edges of the drawing.
title: Copper Tea Kettle
